# React Rich Text Editor UI

The Syncfusion React Rich Text Editor UI package provides a React wrapper for the Rich Text Editor UI component.

## Installation

Install the component and its peer dependencies from npm:

```bash
npm install @syncfusion/ej2-react-richtexteditorui --save
```

## Setup

Import and render `RichTextEditorUIComponent` in the application:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { RichTextEditorUIComponent } from '@syncfusion/ej2-react-richtexteditorui';

export default function App(): React.ReactElement {
    return <RichTextEditorUIComponent />;
}
```
